title: Friend abducted by grays, shows delta-pattern marks

tellings.quote: he said, "I forgot to tell you. They came and got me."

plain: A friend once turned up at Tim Alberino's house and casually said, "I forgot to tell you. They came and got me," meaning he had been taken by grays, the small grey-skinned beings of many abduction stories. Alberino tells Michels he was there for it, and that the friend had marks on him in a triangular, delta-shaped pattern. If true, the marks would be physical traces of an abduction.
